name: Taranowiec (bryła + retekstura Meshy)
description: A lean Aegean galley of the 12th century BC: pitch-black hull, red ochre wale and bow, a white zigzag band along the wale, a square linen sail and a bronze-sheathed spur at the waterline.

texturing.prompt: Pitch-blackened pine planking with visible seams, red ochre wale and bow, white painted zigzag band, weathered off-white linen sail, dull bronze spur; realistic, readable from far away
